text:
amelia: quick post-launch check — need to pick scope for the next 2wk iteration. do we go hard on the 6 top bugs (timeout/regression/perf) or push the embedding consistency enhancement customers asked for? short replies please.

sanjay: from sre — 6 high-sev alerts in 48h. 3 infra noise, 2 request timeouts on dedicated pools, 1 memory bump on runtime. timeouts look reproducible; will need 2 engineers ~3d to root cause.

li: on the feature side: embedding consistency fix is ~3 dev-days and unblocks 2 enterprise customers. streaming UI polish is ~2d and improves perception but not critical.

jordan: CS signal: two enterprise customers flagged the embedding mismatch as showstopper for their pilots. perf is annoying but they may tolerate short degraded windows if we promise timeline.

maya: eng note — quick mitigation for timeouts is fallback routing to a compatible model variant (config + canary rollout). low-risk, I can implement canary today. deep-root cause still needs the 3d investigation.

amelia: proposal: week1 = embedding hotfix (3d) + routing fallback canary; week2 = full timeout RCA + follow-up fixes. decision rule: if CS escalates to legal/SLA, stability trumps. vote with emoji: :thumbsup: = stability-first; :eyes: = run both in parallel; :sparkles: = feature-first.

sanjay: :thumbsup: stability-first. prioritize anything that impacts availability.

li: :eyes: embedding fix and routing can be parallel — small team overlap only. we can ship embedding in <5d.

jordan: :sparkles: CS would prefer embedding fix first but only if we have the routing mitigation ready.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll kick off the canary config and monitoring alerts. need ops approval for additional pool.

deploy-bot: Created task WIND-4321: canary fallback routing + monitoring. link: https://redwood/tasks/WIND-4321

amelia: decision logged: go embedding hotfix + routing canary this iteration. action items: 1) li -> own embedding hotfix, due in 3 business days (WIND-4322). 2) maya -> canary rollout + ops request (WIND-4321). 3) sanjay -> timeout RCA kickoff, schedule follow-up on Friday. 4) jordan -> keep CS updated + escalate if legal/SLA risk. I'll update roadmap and retro notes.

li: noted. I'll post a short changelog PR draft once branch is ready.

sanjay: RCA kickoff on Friday 10am. invite sent.

jordan: i'll ping the two customers with expected timeline and ask for temporary tolerance window.

amelia: thanks all — keeping this thread for status updates. small check-ins only — any major blockers escalate in #eng-oncall. :raised_hands:
